articles.title: Salman Rushdie attacker convicted of terror offenses - BBC
articles.description: Hadi Matar, 28, was convicted of attempting to help Hezbollah by attacking the British-Indian author.
articles.content: They also played videos made by Matar, 28, and interviewed Sir Salman on the witness stand about being stabbed 15 times, including to his cheek, chest, eye, neck and thigh.
